529-969-3197-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4694-5805-6495-7306.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-5805-6495-7306.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat from step 1.
4694-5805-6495-7306.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3899-6553-7424.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

628-2193-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Chainbreaker.
When Chainbreaker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
628-2193-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1325-5170-6132-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Kheru Bloodsucker triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Kheru Bloodsucker trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Bloodsucker trigger, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-1974-4264.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-1974-4264.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Altered Ego and Quicksilver Gargantuan each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-1974-4264.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1379-3197-4017-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1379-3197-4017-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Herd Baloth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4499-4668-7494.easyPrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
4499-4668-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.
4499-4668-7494.notes: Your opponents must have drawn at least two cards this turn for this combo to add infinite mana.

2816-7488.description:
Activate Topiary Lecturer by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to its power.
Activate Topiary Lecturer by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
2816-7488.notes: The amount of mana needed to start is equal to {3} minus Topiary Lecturer's power.

1362-1479-4677.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

889-1618-2440-3992.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Deekah
889-1618-2440-3992.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Cyclical Evolution.
Cyclical Evolution triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Deekah triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Cyclical Evolution.
Repeat.
889-1618-2440-3992.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Deekah. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

240-4927-5470-6797.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

240-2438-4785-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

2324-2448-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2324-2448-5220-6900.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1379-1978-3291.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least three.
1379-1978-3291.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Karametra's Acolyte.
Repeat

1781-1978-3043.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with defender.
1781-1978-3043.description:
Cause Axebane Guardian to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Axebane Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

1414-2866-4986-5315.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

1750-2793-5131-5261-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

292-1495-6260.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-1495-6260.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

3765-5957-6102.manaNeeded: {6}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
3765-5957-6102.notablePrerequisites:
Kianne's power is even.
You have not triggered Ashling's ability this turn.
You have another instant or sorcery spell in hand.
Your deck size is at least 2.
3765-5957-6102.description:
Cast an instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, triggering Ashling.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Ashling triggers, causing you to rummage.
Resolve Worldfire, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to 1.
Resolve the Ashling trigger from step 1, dealling 2 damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having less than 0 life.

1479-3861-4677.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3861-4677.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Zendikar's Roil, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2018-2981-5263.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a flying counter on it.
Resolve both Megatog abilities from steps 1 and 3, giving it +6/+6 until end of turn.
Repeat.

301-2131--42.notablePrerequisites:
Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
It is your turn.
301-2131--42.description:
Activate the Goblin sacrifice outlet by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Goblin sacrifice outlet ability.
Repeat.
This combo will provide infinite results of whatever the Goblin sacrifice outlet produces, which will vary depending on the sacrifice outlet used.

3681-5610.easyPrerequisites: Grafted Exoskeleton attached to Hydra Omnivore.
3681-5610.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block Hydra Omnivore.
You have a way to increase Hydra Omnivore's power by 2 or more, or each opponent has at least two poison counters.
3681-5610.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Hydra Omnivore, causing them to get at least eight poison counters.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.
Hydra Omnivore triggers, causing each other opponent to get at least eight poison counters.
Each remaining opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

859-2325-4613.notablePrerequisites: Lurking Roper has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
859-2325-4613.description:
Activate Lurking Roper using Soulmender's ability by tapping it, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

4101-4285-5195.description:
Cast Pair o' Dice Lost by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Increasing Vengeance by paying {R}{R}, targeting Pair o' Dice Lost.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Increasing Vengeance, copying Pair o' Dice Lost.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Pair o' Dice Lost, causing you to roll two d6 and return Increasing Vengeance and any other applicable card(s) to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

2404-2608-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures.
2404-2608-4499.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.

2406-3149-3718-3807.notablePrerequisites: Swift Reconfiguration attached to Stormchaser Drake.
2406-3149-3718-3807.description:
Cast Chain of Acid by paying {3}{G}, targeting Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, causing you to draw  a card.
Resolve Chain of Acid, failing to destroy Stormchaser Drake and creating a copy of Chain of Acid targeting Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3249-4939.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Burning-Tree Emissary, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Burning-Tree Emissary from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary from your graveyard by paying {R/G}{R/G}.
Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, adding {R}{G}.
Repeat.

1409-2564-3129-4231.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with another creature.
1409-2564-3129-4231.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering its soulbond ability and Lonis.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating two Clue, two Food, and two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and any other creature.
Activate the two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

914-3352-4050.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3352-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {B} or {R}.
Cast Disturbed Burial for its buyback cost by paying {4}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Dockside Extortionist for {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating a number of Treasure tokens equal to the number of artifacts and enchantments your opponent control.
Activate six of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}{R}.
Repeat.

1228-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin attached to Goblin Sharpshooter.
Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to cause a non-Goblin Sharpshooter creature to die (for an additional result).
1228-4702.description:
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter's ability from Splinter Twin by tapping it, creating a token copy of Goblin Sharpshooter with haste.
Activate the token copy of Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
The token copy of Goblin Sharpshooter dies, triggering the nontoken Goblin Sharpshooter, untapping it.
Repeat.
Alternatively, if you have a way to cause any creature besides the Goblin Sharpshooters to die, for instance by targeting a 1-toughness creature in step 2, you can untap Goblin Sharpshooter an additional time and repeat step 1 one additional time before continuing the combo.
This will leave you with one additional surviving Goblin Sharpshooter token, which can activate itself once per loop for infinite damage to any targets.

174-877-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Worldheart Phoenix, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Worldheart Phoenix from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.
